notes.title: Hotfix Patch 0.1.4.33
notes.notes:
A Flawless start


 Tutorial Access Fix: Some content creators didn’t access the tutorial due to a save file issue where the game didn’t transition correctly after the cutscene. This has now been fixed, ensuring that everyone plays the tutorial smoothly and only once.  

 Generator Interaction Feedback: A gameplay notification has been added when attempting to interact with the generator if no blackout has occurred.  


I'm actively refining the game's rough edges to make it shine, so stay tuned: exciting updates are coming!  

For now, enjoy leveling up in the facility! 🚀
